title: Snapshot template bit output
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $n,T,t$ be natural numbers, let $z$ be a finite list of bits, and let $e$ be an eleven-register record. Assume $t\le T$, and that the input-count, hard-wired-length, time-budget, instruction-position, and step-start registers of $e$ equal, respectively, $n$, the length of $z$, $T$, the index of the snapshot position at time $t$ for input length $|z|+n$ and budget $T$, and $t$ times the configuration stride for input length $|z|+n$ and budget $T$. The concatenated output of executing the snapshot template for time $t$ on the register values of $e$ equals the instruction-bit list specified by $M,n,z,T$ at the instruction position recorded in $e$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols
$z$ is a finite list of bits
The hard-wired-length register of $e$ equals the length of $z$
The instruction-position register of $e$ equals the snapshot index for time $t$, input length $|z|+n$, and budget $T$
The step-start register of $e$ equals $t$ times the configuration stride for input length $|z|+n$ and budget $T$
